messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: node rg-eu2-gpu-12 reported 8 Xid 13 and 11 ECC corrected in past 6m; inference tail latency spike 2.6x; auto-drain not completed.
alex: seeing that in console, is this powercap or sensor? logs?
mira: logs attached -> ```NVML: Xid 13: ECC multi-bit at offset 0x3f2
therm_read: sensor 3 jump 72.1C -> 98.4C in 30s
power_limit: 250W -> 160W (hw-pm)
```
shaun: yikes. any physical work done recently?
alex: we had a node reboot last night for kernel patch, maybe clip moved during reseat? could be mechanical.
mira: oncall asked to do quick drain and failover. I'll drain and move active shards to reserved pool.
ops-oncall: starting drain: `redwood node drain --id=rg-eu2-gpu-12 --timeout=300s` -> 12/12 sessions moved :thumbsup: 
infra-bot: drain complete. node marked DRAINING -> MAINT.
shaun: can someone run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,power.draw,clocks.sm --format=csv -l 2` on the host? want a short profile.
mira: ran it, temps still spikey when load applied, power draw oscillates 30W -> 210W within 10s.
alex: I want a photo of the card bracket & heatsink. can infra team look in rack 7, slot 3?
ops-oncall: on my way, will report in 10.
ops-oncall: found heatsink retention clip bent ~30deg, TIM smear uneven, small visible gap along centerline. (attached photo) :face_with_thermometer: 
shaun: that explains poor conduction and thermal runaway -> thermal throttles -> power limiter kicks -> Xid errors. plan: replace card and reseat properly.
mira: short-term mitigation: set power limit to 220W and set clocks to 80% to avoid spikes, plus enable aggressive KV cache warming to reduce burst load.
alex: do we have spare GPU to hot-swap now? what's ETA?
ops-oncall: we have a spare in rack 9, I can swap now; expected downtime for node replacement 12m.
infra-bot: swapping node -> outage window recorded in /incidents/INC-2026-047
mira: after swap, perf normalized. 95th p99 tail lat went from 480ms back to 130ms.
shaun: opened ticket INFRA-6392 for permanent replacement + add heatsink retention inspection to rack checklist.
alex: nice triage. can we add a metric alert for "sensor delta > 20C in 30s" to catch earlier?
mira: yes, will file PR to alerts repo and link in INFRA-6392.
ops-oncall: closing thread after replacement; if anyone needs photos or logs ping me.
